events.content: Bike locks connect over Bluetooth to the rider's phone
Riders pay per ride by card through Adyen
The backend is written in Java with Spring Boot
Rides under 30 minutes are free for subscribers
Bike locks have their own LTE-M modems and are unlocked from the server
events.rationale: Bluetooth unlocks failed on many Android phones

events.content: Migrate rides from Oracle to Postgres to drop licensing costs
Rides under 45 minutes are free for subscribers
Riders top up an in-app wallet through Adyen and rides are deducted from the balance
events.rationale: Per-ride card fees exceeded the price of short rides
